H4258H.name: Mahalath
H4258H.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4258H.short: Mahalath was one of King Rehoboam's wives, a granddaughter of David through his son Jerimoth.

H4258G.name: Mahalath
H4258G.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4258G.short: Mahalath, also known as Basemath, was one of Esau's wives, a daughter of Ishmael.

H4287G.name: Mahath
H4287G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4287G.brief: Levite who helped purify the temple under Hezekiah
H4287G.short: Mahath, a Levite, participated in the purification of the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

H4287H.name: Mahath
H4287H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4287H.brief: Levite who assisted in distributing tithes during Hezekiah's reign.
H4287H.short: Mahath, a Levite, helped distribute tithes in Hezekiah's time.

H4233.name: Mahavites
H4233.brief: Some of David's mighty men, possibly from Mahavim.
H4233.short: The Mahavites were represented among David's mighty men.

H4238.name: Mahazioth
H4238.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4238.brief: Son of Heman, a musician in David's time.
H4238.short: Mahazioth, a son of Heman, served as a musician during David's reign.

H4244H.name: Mahlah
H4244H.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4244H.short: Mahlah was the daughter of Zelophehad's sister.

H4244G.name: Mahlah
H4244G.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4244G.brief: Daughter of Zelophehad, who received an inheritance among her brothers.
H4244G.short: Mahlah, a daughter of Zelophehad, received an inheritance among her brothers.

H4249H.name: Mahli
H4249H.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4249H.brief: Son of Mushi, grandson of Merari.
H4249H.short: Mahli, a son of Mushi and grandson of Merari, was a Levite during the time of David.

H4249G.name: Mahli
H4249G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4249G.brief: Son of Merari, grandson of Levi.
H4249G.short: Mahli, a son of Merari and grandson of Levi, was an ancestor of the Mahlites.

H4248.name: Mahlon
H4248.brief: Husband of Ruth, son of Elimelech and Naomi.
H4248.short: Mahlon, the son of Elimelech and Naomi, married Ruth but died in Moab.

H4235.name: Mahol
H4235.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4235.brief: Father of wise men surpassed in wisdom by Solomon.
H4235.short: Mahol was the father of wise men whom Solomon surpassed in wisdom.

H4271.name: Mahseiah
H4271.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4271.short: Mahseiah was the grandfather of Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe.

H4240.name: Mehida
H4240.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4240.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
H4240.short: Mehida was an ancestor of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H4243.name: Mehir
H4243.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4243.short: Mehir was the son of Chelub.

H4259.name: Meholathites
H4259.brief: People from Abel-meholah, including Adriel and Barzillai.
H4259.short: The Meholathites were people from Abel-meholah, including Adriel, who married Saul's daughter Merab, and Barzillai, whose son married Saul's daughter Michal.

H4232.name: Mehujael
H4232.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H4232.brief: Descendant of Cain; father of Methushael.
H4232.short: Mehujael was a descendant of Cain and the father of Methushael.

H4217G.name: East Gate
H4217G.brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, near the house of Shemaiah.
H4217G.short: The East Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, located near the house of Shemaiah (<ref="Nehemiah 3:29">Nehemiah 3:29</ref>).

H4266.name: Mahanaim
H4266.brief: A place east of the Jordan; David's refuge
H4266.short: Mahanaim, a place east of the Jordan River where Jacob met angels and David found refuge during Absalom's rebellion (<ref="Genesis 32:2; 2Sa.17.24, 27">Genesis 32:2; 2Sa.17.24, 27</ref>).

H4265.name: Mahaneh-dan
H4265.brief: A place between Zorah and Eshtaol; Samson's birthplace
H4265.short: Mahaneh-dan, a place between Zorah and Eshtaol where the Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson (<ref="Judges 13:25; 18:12">Judges 13:25; 18:12</ref>).

H4257.name: Mahalath
H4257.brief: A musical or literary term in the Psalms
H4257.short: Mahalath, mentioned in the superscriptions of Psalms 53 and 88, is a musical or literary term of uncertain meaning.

H4216.name: Mazzaroth
H4216.brief: A term related to astronomy or constellations
H4216.short: Mazzaroth, mentioned in <ref="Job.38.32">Job.38.32</ref>, is a term of uncertain meaning, possibly referring to constellations or the zodiac.
